sources.note: Author taken from the gallery's <Author>-<Theme> folder names

attribution_note: Discord-sourced entries record the account that UPLOADED the file ('posted_by'), which is NOT necessarily its author. Both Discord servers contain re-posts of third-party themes — in 'Renoise Themes & Stuff' the featured (star) channels are moderator-curated; in 'Renoise Community Server' the #themes channel carries requests and re-posts alongside self-posts. Where the accompanying message reveals the real author, it is preserved verbatim in the 'context' field. 'author' is left null rather than guessed. Original authors: open an issue to be credited.

aliases_note: Entries listed in `aliases` are byte-different copies of a theme already archived: either an identical colour map, or the same theme re-uploaded to a second site by its own author. The canonical file is kept in `themes/`; the duplicate's provenance (uploader, date, channel, CDN URL) is preserved here so the record of the upload is not lost.
variant_note: Entries sharing a `variant_group` are deliberate version series by one author (e.g. GoldBlue v1.0-1.2, Amiga OS brightness variants, RC1/RC2), not duplicates. The gallery groups them.
